text:
Which statement about a hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell in a car is correct?
A
The fuel cell produces heat, which powers the car.
B
The fuel cell is supplied with hydrogen directly from the air.
C
The only emission from the fuel cell is nitrogen gas, which is non-polluting.
D
The fuel cell produces electricity, which powers an electric motor.

options.label: A
options.text: The fuel cell produces heat, which powers the car.

options.label: B
options.text: The fuel cell is supplied with hydrogen directly from the air.

options.label: C
options.text: The only emission from the fuel cell is nitrogen gas, which is non-polluting.

options.label: D
options.text: The fuel cell produces electricity, which powers an electric motor.
